lab.inspect.title: Data inspection
lab.inspect.evalDenied: The current role cannot open the evaluation catalog (115 ROLE_FORBIDDEN); the distribution catalog is open
lab.inspect.nativeHint: Run this command in a terminal configured with a bench token. A local proxy adds the authorization header; the command and the link carry no token.
lab.inspect.note.dist: Data from the Rerun catalog (the distribution catalog holds only observation and agent layers). Rerun {version}
lab.inspect.note.eval: Data from the Rerun evaluation catalog (includes truth and evaluation layers). Rerun {version}
lab.inspect.note.static: Data from public time-window slices and the basemap (public tier, read-only). Rerun {version}
lab.inspect.idle.title: Data inspection component not loaded
lab.inspect.idle.hint: The component is about 49 MB; the browser caches it after the first load.
lab.inspect.unsupported.title: This device does not support the data inspection panel
lab.inspect.unsupported.software: The device renders in software (Tier S). Download a time-window slice and open it in the native Rerun Viewer.
lab.inspect.unsupported.nogpu: The browser provides neither WebGL2 nor WebGPU. Download a time-window slice and open it in the native Rerun Viewer.
lab.inspect.unsupported.simd: The browser does not support WebAssembly SIMD. Download a time-window slice and open it in the native Rerun Viewer.
lab.inspect.unsupported.layout: Data inspection is not offered in phone and tablet layouts. Download a time-window slice and open it in the native Rerun Viewer.
lab.inspect.error.version: Data inspection could not open the recording (694 RERUN_VERSION_MISMATCH). The recording must be migrated before viewing.
lab.inspect.error.role: The current role cannot open this catalog (115 ROLE_FORBIDDEN).
lab.inspect.error.notFound: This run is not registered in the selected catalog (305 NOT_FOUND). Test-split runs are not in the distribution catalog.
lab.inspect.error.session: The workspace session is no longer valid (302 TOKEN_INVALID). Sign in again.
lab.inspect.error.timeout: Data inspection could not open the recording within 10 s. Check that rerun-proxy and the catalog service are available, then retry.
lab.inspect.error.load: The data inspection component failed to load. The browser must support WebAssembly SIMD and either WebGL2 or WebGPU.
lab.inspect.error.credential: The recording link contains credentials and was not opened.
lab.inspect.error.static: The sample slice is outside the public static artifacts or exceeds the 64 MB per-slice limit and was not opened.
lab.inspect.error.unknown: Data inspection could not open the recording.
